description: Erection of a single storey rear side infill extension; erection of obscured glazed screens around part of the flat roof of back addition at second floor level in connection with its use as a terrace; installation of a new window opening at first floor level and infilling of 1no existing window at ground floor level to the rear elevation; alterations to the roof of ground floor rear back addition to include the infilling of existing rooflight and installation of 3no new rooflights.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Walls: Render to match the existing building in terms of colour, texture and appearance.
- Roof: Slate or slate appearance tiles to match the existing.
- Windows and doors: Timber framed, painted white, style, detail and finish to match the existing.

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. 

Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1 and DC4 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - With the exception of the area shown as a terrace on the approved plans, no part of the remainder of the roof atop of the existing back addition or the roof of the ground floor extension shall be converted into or used as a terrace or other open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the roofs. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected around the roofs and no alterations shall be carried out to the property to form an access onto the roofs.

Such a use would be detrimental to the amenities of neighbouring properties by reason of overlooking and loss of privacy and potential noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies CC11 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 5 - The terrace hereby approved shall not be first used until the obscure glazed glass screening has been fitted to the rear and northern side boundaries (as shown on drawing no. PL 102 A & PL 105 A). The screening shall have a height of 1.7m above the finished floor level of the terrace and shall achieve a minimum level of obscurity of Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3 (or equivalent), fixed and designed so as to prevent direct views through it. The screening shall thereafter be permanently retained as approved.

To protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers in terms of overlooking and privacy in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 6 - The development shall be carried out and completed in full accordance with the details contained within the approved Flood Risk Assessment (dated 29.06.2026). No part of the development shall be used or occupied until all flood resilience measures have been installed in accordance with the submitted details and the development shall be permanently retained in this form and maintained as necessary thereafter. 

To limit the impact on flood risk and mitigate the susceptibility of the development to flooding in accordance with Policies CC2, CC3 and CC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
